resources.name: companies
resources.title: Listed wine companies
resources.description: Every company in the BoomCellar register: the index constituents, the listed wine companies tracked but not indexed, those excluded and why, and those that have left the market.

fields.name: bc_id
fields.description: Permanent BoomCellar company ID. Never reused.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Company name.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Indexed · Tracked, not indexed · Eligible, awaiting reconstitution · Excluded · Delisted.

fields.name: status_detail
fields.description: Why a tracked or excluded company is not in the index (for example below the 50% wine-revenue rule).

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Ticker as used by BoomCellar (Yahoo Finance convention, exchange suffix included).

fields.name: former_tickers
fields.description: Earlier tickers of the same listing, separated by |.

fields.name: exchange
fields.description: Listing venue.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country of the listing's home market.

fields.name: trading_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency the share trades in.

fields.name: isin
fields.description: ISIN of the listed share. Empty = not found.

fields.name: isin_source
fields.description: primary (issuer or exchange filing) · gleif (GLEIF LEI–ISIN record) · cross-checked (two identifier services agree) · sec-cusip (built from the CUSIP on the company's SEC filing) · secondary (one dated secondary record — see identifier_note).

fields.name: lei
fields.description: Legal Entity Identifier from GLEIF. Empty = none in GLEIF (many companies never registered one).

fields.name: lei_status
fields.description: GLEIF status: ISSUED · LAPSED (not renewed, still the entity's identifier) · RETIRED (entity ended).

fields.name: lei_basis
fields.description: gleif-isin (GLEIF links the LEI to this ISIN) · gleif-name (legal name and country match).

fields.name: identifier_note
fields.description: What the identifier search found, and why a value is missing.

fields.name: figi
fields.description: OpenFIGI share-class FIGI of the ISIN (one per security, across every venue). Empty = no ISIN, or OpenFIGI has no record.

fields.name: mic
fields.description: ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code of the listing venue (the segment's own code where ISO lists one, for example AIMX for AIM).

fields.name: primary_listing
fields.description: TRUE if the ticker is the company's primary listing; FALSE for a depositary receipt. Empty for a company that has left the market.

fields.name: incorporation_country
fields.description: Jurisdiction of formation (ISO 3166) from the company's GLEIF LEI record. Empty without an LEI.

fields.name: incorporation_source
fields.description: The GLEIF record it was read from.

fields.name: reporting_currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency of the company's reported results, from a filing in the results register. Empty until one is recorded.

fields.name: fiscal_year_end
fields.description: Month and day (MM-DD) the fiscal year ends, as a filed annual report states it.

fields.name: fiscal_year_end_source
fields.description: The report the fiscal year end was read from.

fields.name: wine_member_from
fields.description: Date the company joined BCWINE (the base date for a launch constituent).

fields.name: wine_member_to
fields.description: Date the company was removed from BCWINE. Empty while it is a member.

fields.name: in_wine
fields.description: TRUE if a constituent of BCWINE (global) today.

fields.name: in_cru
fields.description: TRUE if a constituent of BCCRU (boutique, below €100m) today.

fields.name: in_east
fields.description: TRUE if a constituent of BCEAST (Asia-Pacific) today.

fields.name: weight_wine_pct
fields.description: Weight in BCWINE today, percent.

fields.name: price_local
fields.description: Latest close in the trading currency (constituents only).

fields.name: price_date
fields.description: Session of that close.

fields.name: shares_outstanding_m
fields.description: Shares outstanding used for market capitalisation, millions. For index constituents, the filed count adopted at the reconstitution of 2 October 2026 (Bodegas Riojanas: the listed line; Changyu: the A line only).

fields.name: shares_source_url
fields.description: Filing the share count was read from, where recorded.

fields.name: shares_as_of
fields.description: Date the share count refers to, where recorded.

fields.name: shares_filed_m
fields.description: Latest filed shares outstanding, millions, all classes summed (read 2026-09-30). Constituents price on it since the reconstitution of 2 October 2026, except where shares_outstanding_m names a rule.

fields.name: shares_filed_classes
fields.description: The filed count by share class: class=millions@date, separated by |.

fields.name: shares_source_locator
fields.description: Where in the filing the share count is printed (note, page).

fields.name: market_cap_usd_m
fields.description: Price × shares, US dollars, millions (constituents only).

fields.name: market_cap_eur_m
fields.description: Price × shares, euros, millions (constituents only).

fields.name: wine_revenue_share_pct
fields.description: Share of revenue from selling wine, percent, from the company's own segment or product reporting. Blank where the company does not split it out.

fields.name: wine_share_basis
fields.description: Fiscal year and how the wine share was read, or why it is blank.

fields.name: wine_share_source_url
fields.description: Report the wine share was read from.

fields.name: in_2015_universe
fields.description: TRUE if the company was in the original 2015 BoomCellar universe.

fields.name: in_register_since
fields.description: Date the company entered the register (or the dated event that put it there).

fields.name: in_register_since_basis
fields.description: exact · month · year (as precise as the record) · on_or_before (the register carried it by that date) · unread (an exit whose own date was not read; the date is then blank).

fields.name: left_market_on
fields.description: Delisting date, for delisted companies.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Public note on the company's status.

fields.name: page_url
fields.description: Where the company is shown on boomcellar.com.

resources.name: delisted
resources.title: Delisted wine companies
resources.description: Wine companies that have left the stock market, how they left and when, with the evidence for each — the survivorship record behind the index.

fields.name: bc_id
fields.description: Permanent BoomCellar company ID.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Company name at the time it left.

fields.name: last_ticker
fields.description: Last ticker, where known.

fields.name: venue
fields.description: Exchange it left.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country.

fields.name: how_it_left
fields.description: Taken private · Squeeze-out · Merged · Insolvency · Voluntary delisting · Wound down · Delisting approved (scheduled).

fields.name: cause_code
fields.description: Machine code of how_it_left.

fields.name: effective_date
fields.description: Date the exit took effect. Empty = not established.

fields.name: date_basis
fields.description: What that date is (for example the last day of trading, or the date the squeeze-out completed).

fields.name: acquirer
fields.description: Buyer, where there was one.

fields.name: consideration
fields.description: Price paid or deal value, as the source states it.

fields.name: premium
fields.description: Premium paid, as the source states it.

fields.name: evidence_tier
fields.description: 1 = exchange, regulator or company filing · 2 = court or specialist register · 3 = press only.

fields.name: evidence_tier_label
fields.description: The tier in words.

fields.name: primary_source_url
fields.description: The first source for the row.

fields.name: source_urls
fields.description: Every source, separated by |.

fields.name: open_questions
fields.description: What the evidence does not establish.

resources.name: calendar
resources.title: Wine stock investor calendar
resources.description: Results, AGMs, dividends and other dated events for listed wine companies, each read from the company's own calendar or filing, with a record of whether the date held.

fields.name: event_key
fields.description: Stable key: ticker|event type|date.

fields.name: bc_id
fields.description: Permanent BoomCellar company ID.

fields.name: company
fields.description: Company name.

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Ticker.

fields.name: in_index
fields.description: TRUE if the company is a BCWINE constituent.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Machine code (results, agm, ex-dividend, …).

fields.name: event_type_label
fields.description: Event type in words.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Event date, local exchange date.

fields.name: date_confidence
fields.description: confirmed · provisional · estimated (a confirmed date whose source is over 90 days old reads provisional).

fields.name: estimate_basis
fields.description: For an estimated date, the rule that produced it.

fields.name: label
fields.description: The company's own wording for the event.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Where the date was read.

fields.name: source_checked
fields.description: Date the source was last read.

fields.name: status
fields.description: upcoming · unrecorded (date passed, outcome not yet checked) · recorded.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: For recorded events: occurred-as-scheduled · occurred-on-another-date · did-not-occur.

fields.name: occurred_on
fields.description: Actual date, when it differed.

fields.name: outcome_verified_on
fields.description: Date the outcome was checked.

fields.name: outcome_source_url
fields.description: Where the outcome was read.

resources.name: ipo-pipeline
resources.title: Wine IPO pipeline
resources.description: Wine companies preparing to list, with each filing stage dated from the filing or the exchange.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Registrant's legal name, as filed.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Where the wine is made.

fields.name: incorporated
fields.description: Jurisdiction of the listing entity, where different.

fields.name: venue
fields.description: Venue(s) named in the filing.

fields.name: reserved_ticker
fields.description: Ticker reserved with the exchange (reserved is not trading).

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Trading ticker, once listed.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: confidential-draft · filed · priced · listed · postponed · withdrawn.

fields.name: stage_label
fields.description: Stage in words.

fields.name: stage_date
fields.description: Date the current stage was entered.

fields.name: open
fields.description: TRUE while the listing is still in progress.

fields.name: expected_date
fields.description: Expected listing date, only where the company or exchange published one.

fields.name: expected_basis
fields.description: Where that date was published.

fields.name: wine_share
fields.description: What the filing says about the wine share of the business.

fields.name: source_kind
fields.description: filing · exchange · company.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Primary source.

fields.name: source_checked
fields.description: Date the source was last read.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Public qualifier on the company's disclosure.

resources.name: changes
resources.title: Changes log
resources.description: Every dated change to the methodology, the index membership and the register, newest first — the audit trail behind the published figures.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the change (for corporate actions, the date of the event).

fields.name: area
fields.description: methodology · index · register · corporate action.

fields.name: bc_id
fields.description: Company ID, where the change concerns a company.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: What changed.

fields.name: change
fields.description: The change, in words.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Commit of a methodology change, or the source of a company change.

resources.name: results
resources.title: Results register
resources.description: Reported results of listed wine companies: one row per figure, per company, per period, as the issuer published it, with the filing it was read from.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable row ID: ticker-period end-metric.

fields.name: bc_id
fields.description: Permanent BoomCellar company ID.

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Ticker.

fields.name: period_kind
fields.description: H1 · H2 · Q1–Q4 · FY, as the issuer reports.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: Last day of the reporting period.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: revenue · wine_revenue_share · dividend_per_share · net_result.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The figure as published, in scale units of currency.

fields.name: prior_value
fields.description: The same period a year earlier, same basis, as published. Empty = not read.

fields.name: scale
fields.description: unit · thousand · million · billion.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency of the figure (% for a share).

fields.name: basis
fields.description: reported · comparable (the issuer's like-for-like scope) · restated.

fields.name: standing
fields.description: reported (the issuer's own publication) · filed (a filing read through a relay).

fields.name: reported_on
fields.description: Date the issuer published the figure.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The filing the figure was read from.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Where in the filing.

fields.name: source_accessed
fields.description: Date the filing was read.

fields.name: brief_issue
fields.description: Monthly Brief issue that recorded the row.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the figure is and is not.

resources.name: levels-wine-ew
resources.title: WINE Equal Weight (companion series) — levels record
resources.description: WINE Equal Weight (companion series): one row per session, append-only, SHA-256 chained. Resets every constituent to 1/N at the close of the last trading session of each calendar quarter, from the 2026-12-31 session.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Session date (ISO 8601).

fields.name: level_usd
fields.description: Published level in US dollars, four decimals.

fields.name: level_eur
fields.description: The same level in euro, each session at its own rate.

fields.name: level_local
fields.description: The level with exchange rates held at the base date.

fields.name: constituents
fields.description: Members in the series on that session.

fields.name: live_quotes
fields.description: Members with a live quote on that session.

fields.name: methodology
fields.description: Methodology version in force when the row was recorded.

fields.name: recorded_at
fields.description: When the row was written (UTC).

fields.name: late
fields.description: 1 when the row was recorded after its session's own night.

fields.name: inputs_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the inputs the level used (not published).

fields.name: prev_sha256
fields.description: The previous row's row_sha256.

fields.name: row_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of this row's cells and prev_sha256.

fields.name: divisor
fields.description: Basket value the level divides: close × dollar rate × shares (millions) over the members, ÷ (level ÷ 100). Blank for equal weighting.

fields.name: event_ref
fields.description: The continuity-ledger event in force on the session (events/<series>.jsonl#<line>).

resources.name: listed-wine-map
resources.title: Listed Wine Map
resources.description: Estates, wineries, vineyards and cellars owned or run as their own by the constituents of the BoomCellar Wine Stock Index, one row per site, each with the filing or official page it was read from. Coordinates from Wikidata (CC0).

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable site ID.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The site's own name.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: estate (vineyard and winery at one site) · winery · vineyard · cellars.

fields.name: status
fields.description: owned (owned, or run as its own) · leased · divested · unverified, as the filing states.

fields.name: bc_id
fields.description: Permanent BoomCellar company ID of the listed owner.

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: The listed owner's ticker.

fields.name: company
fields.description: The listed owner.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: The consumer brand most associated with the site; empty when none.

fields.name: locality
fields.description: Town or village as the source names it.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Wine region or appellation as the source names it.

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Street address as the company gives it; empty when none.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: WGS84 latitude, from Wikidata.

fields.name: lon
fields.description: WGS84 longitude, from Wikidata.

fields.name: coord_level
fields.description: point = the site's own Wikidata item; locality = the town's centre; none = not placed.

fields.name: hectares
fields.description: Vineyard hectares a primary source states for this site; empty = not stated (never estimated).

fields.name: hectares_basis
fields.description: What the hectares count, and any unit conversion.

fields.name: stake_pct
fields.description: The listed company's holding in the entity that holds the site, as filed; empty = not stated.

fields.name: evidence_grade
fields.description: high = the filing states the site is the company's; medium = it names the company's or a controlled subsidiary's operating site without stating title.

fields.name: grade_basis
fields.description: Why, in one sentence.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The filing or official page the ownership is read from.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Where in that document.

fields.name: visit_url
fields.description: The official page offering visits or tastings; empty = none found.

fields.name: checked
fields.description: The date the row was read at source.
